peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 2.1% above its local comparables; 63 of 85 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (100.0): 11.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 266 of 266 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 25% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $730,000 ($1,727 psf, 419–430 sq ft; 5 resales, Jan 2024–Dec 2025); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,692 psf (range $1,548–1,816); 2.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $15,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Serangoon MRT about 500 m, Woodleigh MRT about 650 m; closer than 263 of 462 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest Yangzheng Primary School about 460 m; more than 59 of 462 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 570 m), more than 288 of 462 similar developments (the same as 94); nearest hawker centre Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre about 660 m; nearest park Bidadari Park Hillock about 350 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 1,010 m; Jansen House, 10 new sales, about 1,660 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 141 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 647 resales (772 purchases); new sales were 16.2% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 1,410 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 647 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 198 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 647 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 766 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−15.5%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
